title: Our AI couldn't see the Plasma era, so we fixed it
headline: Our AI couldn't see the Plasma era, so we fixed it.
dek: We asked Mission Control's card model about three Plasma Storm PSA 10s. It gave no read: their era, Black & White, was outside the sets it knew. We added the era, with a proposed history rating for each set, and it reads all three. A check on the model, not a pick.
why_now: The fix went in on Oct 5 as version m1.1; on Oct 6 we ran both versions on PSA population counts read that day.
risk: More than half of each read is judgment, and without Plasma Storm's proposed history rating (Jack to confirm) there's no read.
what_to_watch: The model is still blind to Diamond & Pearl, Platinum, HeartGold SoulSilver and every set after Black & White.
source: PSA population report via Pikawiz, read Oct 6, 2026; Mission Control's card model, versions m1.0 and m1.1, run Oct 6, 2026

before.note: re-run Oct 6, 2026 on the same PSA 10 counts (it takes no total graded)

foot: Measured: the share of the model's weight that has inputs; under 50% it gives no read. Before: version m1.0, re-run Oct 6, 2026 on the same PSA 10 counts (it takes no total graded). After: version m1.1, current since Oct 5, 2026. Population: PSA population report via Pikawiz, read Oct 6, 2026; PSA 10 is the top grade, so none grade higher. Plasma Storm's history rating is proposed, Jack to confirm; character demand is Jack's judgment. No sales or prices were checked for these PSA 10s, so liquidity and price are not measured. Any TCGplayer move shown for these cards elsewhere on the board is not part of this File. No score is shown: each read is low confidence and more than half judgment. Not a pick, not a forecast, not advice.
